files.README.md:
# Winterslow Rope Access - manuals

The office keeps the working manual for each discipline. Inspectors take the issue of the safety manual that covers their work to site.
files.manual/safety-manual.md:
# Winterslow Rope Access - safety manual

Edition 5 of this manual applies to inspection work carried out between 1 April 2026 and 31 March 2027. Earlier editions apply only to work carried out before the date they were replaced.

## What changed in this edition

Anchor checks are recorded on the site sheet as well as in the inspection log.
Rescue drills are run at the start of each contract.
files.notes/equipment.md:
# Equipment notes

Harnesses are quarantined by the stores team after a fall arrest and go to the maker for inspection.
Helmet shells are replaced on the maker's schedule.
